scientific_question: Can the measured parent be related to source-named apo and inhibitor-derived deposited states without assuming exact chemical or physical preparation identity?

result.missing_evidence: An unambiguous atom/bond/protonation mapping between inhibitor3, the source-described Schiff-base/vinylogous-amide state and the deposited protein-plus-LLK graph; resolution of complex crystallization pH4.5 versus7.5.
result.stopping_condition_met: A supported construct-level relation plus a specific chemical-state mapping limitation; no need for a generic distance catalogue.

primary_source.scope: Materials p2; crystallization/refinement p10; sequence FigureS6a p23; FiguresS8/S9 pp25-26; TableS2 p31. Main article body remains unacquired and unassessed.

sequence_correspondence.normalization: Remove only whitespace from deposited canonical one-letter sequence. Both full strings equal the printed parent including starting Met and LEHHHHHH; no trimming or residue renumbering.
sequence_correspondence.chemical_difference: Both deposits encode MHO at label237, parentMET; canonicalM is a parent-residue mapping, not chemical identity.
sequence_correspondence.coordinate_coverage: A full deposited polymer sequence is not a full coordinate model; exact missing-residue rows are retained. No globally constant author-number offset is assumed.
sequence_correspondence.physical_preparation_identity_status: not established by source naming or canonical sequence equality

source_deposit_model_conflict.source: SI Methods p10 says residues58-63 could not be modeled in both structures.
source_deposit_model_conflict.decision: Preserve source statement and current deposited model separately; no coordinate deletion, inferred revision cause or sequence mismatch.

deposit_tag_scope.source: 5AOU _struct_ref_seq_dif annotates246-258 as expression tag; source packet separately retains the explicit terminal251-258LEHHHHHH suffix.
deposit_tag_scope.decision: Retain both scopes; no asserted universal tag boundary or trimming.

sequence_correspondence.initiator_methionine_limit: The printed and deposited canonical strings include Met1, unmodeled in both crystals. SI TableS4 calculates intact mass without initialMet. No exact mature N-terminus or specimen sequence is inferred.

mho_oxygen_occupancy.scope: Only the named extra oxygen is partial occupancy in theseMHO rows; no inferred unoxidized population or functional effect.

states.source_assignment: SI TableS2 maps apoRA95.5-8F to5AOU; primary citation and deposit title agree.
states.chemical_scope: No inhibitor in this source comparison; phosphate, ethylene glycol, water and MHO237 remain present. Apo does not mean chemically empty.

states.source_assignment: SI TableS2 maps RA95.5-8F/inhibitor3 complex to5AN7. Materials names3 as1-(6-methoxynaphthalen-2-yl)butane-1,3-dione. The source describes a Schiff-base complex and compares its twisted geometry with the planar configuration expected for vinylogous amide4; this does not identify the isolated deposited LLK definition as intact3.

source_preparation.identity_limit: This preparation differs from the29C substrate-cleavage assay; no shared aliquot or active fraction established.
source_preparation.cryoprotection: Mother liquor supplemented with25%(v/v)ethylene glycol; flash frozen in liquid nitrogen.

covalent_state_evidence.source_report: SI FiguresS8/S9 describe a Schiff-base complex of the1,3-diketone inhibitor.
covalent_state_evidence.deposit_prose: _pdbx_entry_details.nonpolymer_details calls CC1 covalently bonded to lysine2083.
covalent_state_evidence.numbering_conflict: 5AN7 polymer lysine83 is author1083, not2083. No silently repaired source token; apo5AOU uses2083.
covalent_state_evidence.typed_connection_inventory: Both _struct_conn rows connect the MHO237 peptide backbone; none names LLK or Lys83.
covalent_state_evidence.coordinate_context: Lys83NZ-to-LLKC13 distancesA1.274005/B1.291032angstrom are close contacts compatible with the source-reported attachment, but do not create a typed bond or select a tautomer.

selected_carbonyl_context.source_relation: FigureS8 describes contact of the remaining ligand carbonyl withTyr51.
selected_carbonyl_context.interpretation: Separate coordinate-only alternatives against the sole ligand instance, not jointly observed ligand geometries. TheB distance1.776955angstrom must not be labeled a coexistent contact or hydrogen bond. No averaging or inferred proton position.

ligand_dictionary_coordinate_conflict.decision: Do not repair names, valence, bond order or tautomer; component dictionary and coordinate atom inventories are not an unambiguous complete adduct graph. Hydrogen coordinates or alternate naming do not independently establish protonation.

design_use.added_relation: The exact parent functional endpoints and both deposit contexts are retrievable together, with partial chemical identity and source conflicts made explicit. This prevents attaching a clean productive-template label from a PDB name or canonical sequence.
not_established: Microscopic catalytic step, proton-transfer sequence or solution geometry
Mutant structural effects or isolated role of any catalytic group
Exact graph of the inhibitor-protein adduct, unique protonation or bond order
Independent human review, project experiment, evidence-tier promotion or design performance
design_use.reuse: One generic exact-canonical-sequence state link joins existing observations and generic deposit projections; source chemistry stays in data. Three generic CIF category selections added.
design_use.incumbent_boundary: A competent reader can assemble these sources manually; no measured time saving or incumbent superiority. The added result is an executable association with prevented unsupported transfer.

source_scope_note: Original ligand pairs follow SI Figures S8/S9. The added parent Tyr51OH-to-Tyr180OH pair asks whether the two substituted groups in the existing Table S1 tyrosine square share one deposited separation across the apo and inhibitor-derived contexts. Figure S9 also names Ser81/ordered waters and Met182 sulfur-pi packing; neither pair selection is a complete contact inventory or an assignment of elementary causal roles.

functional_context.scope: Parent steady-state cleavage parameter row only; same construct identity does not transfer synthesis or thermal endpoints into this declared relation.

parent_tyrosine_pair_assessment.question: Do the retained parent deposits establish one invariant Tyr51OH-to-Tyr180OH separation that could strengthen interpretation of the existing Y51F/Y180F functional square?
parent_tyrosine_pair_assessment.functional_scope: The existing --state-link ra95_2017:RA95.5-8F-states --with-comparisons query retains all four source cells and Table S1 thermal context. Only parent observations are state-linked; mutant rows receive no deposited geometry.
parent_tyrosine_pair_assessment.interpretation: The inhibitor-derived deposit includes one shorter Tyr51 alternative and one longer alternative relative to the apo OH separation. These retained coordinates do not establish a single invariant Tyr-pair distance. This narrow negative audit neither strengthens a causal interpretation of the functional square nor refutes the source authors' broader network/preorganization interpretation.
limits: Different crystal media and unresolved complex pH prevent a ligand-induced-motion attribution.
Distances and individual occupancies do not establish a hydrogen bond, proton location, correlated alternate state or solution population.
The thermal panel and composite kinetic parameters do not isolate a Tyr-Tyr interaction, microscopic coupling energy or mutant geometry.
No productive-state geometry, transferable design distance or experimentally validated design rule is established.
Co-retrieval of same-study structure, kinetics and thermal evidence is not independent corroboration of a mechanism.
parent_tyrosine_pair_assessment.reuse: Both coordinate pairs use the unchanged deposit/assembly projector; the unchanged state-link and comparison filter co-retrieve the parent audit and existing kinetic/thermal evidence. This prevents treating one selected alternate as an invariant edge, but adds no causal constraint to the functional square. Scientific applicability and interpretation remain manually reviewed declarations; no generalization or measured curation-time saving.
